callSiteSpecializedCastHistoryObservatio.purpose: Display-only call-site-specialized wrapper observations. Existing global cast histories are unchanged.
callSiteSpecializedCastHistoryObservatio.solverInvariant: Callee wrappers are not fed back into recursive summaries, global histories, project solved summaries, or SCC solving.

callSiteSpecializedExperimentData.purpose: Compact call-site-specialized observations for experiments. This section intentionally avoids the verbose duplicated evidence used by human-readable debug JSON.
callSiteSpecializedExperimentData.solverInvariant: Display-only call-site wrappers are not fed back into recursive summaries, global histories, project solved summaries, or SCC solving.
callSiteSpecializedExperimentData.strictTypePreservingRule: TYPE_PRESERVING_OBSERVED requires terminal selected type to match actual type and no intermediate different concrete non-void pointer type in the callee-specialized path.
callSiteSpecializedExperimentData.supportedSpecialization: simple integer actuals for guards such as tag == 0, tag != 1, !, &&, and ||

callSiteSpecializedFunctionClassificatio.purpose: Display-only call-site-specialized function classification. Existing global function classifications are unchanged.
callSiteSpecializedFunctionClassificatio.solverInvariant: Callee wrappers and guard-specialized call-site views are not fed back into solved summaries, global histories, or SCC solving.
callSiteSpecializedFunctionClassificatio.strictTypePreservingRule: TYPE_PRESERVING_OBSERVED requires the terminal selected type to match the actual type and the callee path to contain no other concrete non-void pointer type.
callSiteSpecializedFunctionClassificatio.supportedSpecialization: simple integer actuals for guards such as tag == 0, tag != 1, !, &&, and ||
